subject: Kickoff workshop — hybrid room booking, routing & load‑test plans
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@stellarpayments.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — POC kickoff and logistics

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering lead (Ben) and cloud ops (Sara) want to do a hands‑on kickoff where we:
- walk through prompt review and routing setup
- run a few short load tests to validate throughput targets
- verify recording/screen permissions for compliance

We have folks available the week of July 20th. At this stage we prefer an in‑person session at our SF office (101 Market St) but can do hybrid if Redwood needs to bring extra hardware.

Can you propose a 3‑hour block? Also let me know if you need visitor badges — our building requires a list 48 hours in advance.

Cheers,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director, Platform Engineering
Stellar Payments
liam@stellarpayments.com

Attachment: internal_requirements.docx (referenced)

Hi Liam — great to hear the team wants a hands‑on kickoff. Proposed options (3‑hour blocks):
• Tue 21 Jul 09:00–12:00 PT
• Wed 22 Jul 13:00–16:00 PT
• Thu 23 Jul 10:00–13:00 PT

We can run the workshop hybrid — Marissa will bring our load testing rig (NVIDIA A2 fleet) if you want on‑prem capacity to validate routing and KV cache behavior. If you prefer us remote, we'll request video + a presenter laptop with screen sharing.

Quick asks:
1) If onsite, please confirm visitor list (full names + photo ID types) 48h prior.
2) Are recordings allowed? If so, who should be excluded for compliance?
3) Any firewall/NAT rules we should know about for the load tests (IP ranges listed below)?

I attached a draft agenda (agenda_v2.pdf) and a site access form (site_access_form.pdf) for the badges.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez

alex@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415‑555‑0132

Liam

Thanks team — booking notes:
- I reserved Conference Room A at 101 Market St for Tue 21 Jul 08:30–12:30 to give us buffer and AV setup time. Room has HDMI + USB‑C and an in‑room Zoom board.
- I've added the event to the shared calendar (see link). Please confirm the presenter laptop will support HDMI 2.0; I ordered an adapter set just in case.
- Marissa (me) will bring our load test controller. Karthik — can you bring the quantized model snapshot we'll use for routing verification?

Liam — confirmed for Tue 21 Jul 09:00–12:00 in Conference Room A. Final checklist: 
- Visitor badges: we will email scanned IDs to you by EOD Mon 19 Jul (Marissa/Karthik).
- Recording: we'll record the session but will mute/save a separate track for any segments that touch cardholder data per your guidance.
- Firewall: thanks — please ping when your ops team confirms the rules are live so we can schedule the short load spikes.
- Load test plan: Marissa, Karthik — 3 rounds: 50rpm (baseline), 200rpm (expected), 600rpm (burst). Keep 5‑min steady windows, 2‑min ramp.

If you need to reschedule, we can also do Wed 22 Jul 13:00–16:00 — but please confirm quickly so I can cancel the room if needed.

See you all soon — Alex
